title: Scandinavian-Style Rice Porridge
description: This Scandinavian-style rice porridge recipe slowly cooks rice in milk and butter for extra-creamy, tender results. Cardamom and cinnamon add extra flavor.
ingredients: 8 whole green cardamom pods, lightly crushed to remove seeds, discarding pods
3 tablespoons unsalted butter, or amount desired

steps.text: Crush cardamom seeds with a rolling pin until very fine; place in a deep heavy pan. Add milk, rice, and 1 cup butter; cook over medium heat, while slowly stirring, for 90 minutes. Reduce heat if necessary to prevent milk from boiling or overheating. Stir in sugar; continue cooking until thickens, about 15 minutes more.
Pour rice mixture into a serving bowl. Add 3 tablespoons butter on top; let melt. Dust with cinnamon. Serve warm or cold.
